hero.headline: Every child deserves a chance to thrive.
hero.paragraph: Become the partner who changes what's possible. In the Avé Prefecture of Togo, 18,000 people are waiting for their first health center. Education is within reach. Girls are ready to lead. All that's missing is you.

story.label: Our Story
story.title: Born from a refusal to stand by
story.paragraph: It all began with a feeling that something wasn't right. Too many children were growing up without protection, without support, without access to education or health care. A group of young people from Avé decided they could no longer do nothing.
story.quote: The people of Kpotamé are not waiting for help — they are inviting you into partnership, not dependency.

programs.label: What We Do
programs.title: Four pillars of community transformation
programs.intro: Our programs are interconnected — a child in school, a mother with skills, a family with healthcare, a community with a voice.

items.title: Education & Sponsorship
items.text: Supporting underprivileged children with family sponsorship programs to ensure school access and long-term retention.

items.title: Rural Healthcare
items.text: Building the Kpotamé Health Center for Women & Children to bring maternal, pediatric, and emergency care to 18,000+ people.

items.title: Girls & Women's Empowerment
items.text: Vocational training in sewing, hairdressing, and entrepreneurship — equipping young women to build independent futures.

items.title: Civic Education
items.text: Community awareness, village assemblies, and civic engagement to build active, informed, and resilient communities.

impact.label: Impact 2023 – 2025
impact.title: Three years. Real numbers. Real lives.
impact.intro: Across education, health, WASH, and women's empowerment — measurable change in rural Togo.

spotlight.label: Flagship Project
spotlight.title: Rural Health Center for Women & Children — Kpotamé
spotlight.text: In this cluster of 17 villages, more than 18,000 people travel up to 40 km for basic care. We are changing that — together.

milestones.title: Site preparation complete
milestones.detail: Land contributed by the Kpotamé community

items.quote: Every day, families face preventable risks. Mothers giving birth without skilled care. Children treated too late for malaria. APED is working to change this reality — and they're doing it the right way, with and for the community.
items.name: Kokou Delali KODJOVI-NUMADO

items.quote: The apprenticeship program changed my life. I now have my own salon and can provide for my children. APED gave me the skills and the confidence to stand on my own.
items.name: Apprentice Graduate

items.quote: When a mother no longer walks 20 km for care, when a child can be treated the same day symptoms begin — an entire community changes. That is what we are building together.
items.name: Senyo KODJOVI-NUMADO
